title: Analytics Across Athletics
description: Are you passionate about sports and curious how data is transforming the game? This course offers a hands-on introduction to sports analytics through projects, discussions, and guest speakers. You'll explore how data informs athletic performance, strategy, and decision-making while gaining practical skills in organizing, analyzing, and visualizing data. Learn where data comes from--like databases, GPS trackers, and surveys--and how to tell meaningful stories with it. We'll also discuss privacy, consent, ethics, and bias in sports data.
